description: This file defines the ConfigService class, which manages configuration settings for the OrangeHRM application, including retrieving and setting configuration values related to localization, security policies, integrations, and other system parameters.

classes.name: ConfigService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing application configuration settings, including retrieval, updating, and auxiliary methods related to system parameters.

methods.name: getConfigDao
methods.description: Lazy initialization and getter for the ConfigDao object used to access configuration data.

methods.name: setConfigDao
methods.description: Setter for injecting a custom ConfigDao instance, useful for testing or alternative data sources.

methods.name: _getConfigValue
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve raw configuration value by key from the data access layer.

methods.name: _setConfigValue
methods.description: Internal method to set or update a configuration value by key in the data layer.

methods.name: isTimesheetPeriodDefined
methods.description: Checks whether the timesheet period has been set in the configuration.

methods.name: isSupervisorChainSupported
methods.description: Determines if the supervisor chain feature is supported based on configuration.

methods.name: setSupervisorChainSupported
methods.description: Enables or disables supervisor chain support in configuration.

methods.name: setShowPimDeprecatedFields
methods.description: Sets whether deprecated PIM fields should be shown.

methods.name: showPimDeprecatedFields
methods.description: Gets whether deprecated PIM fields are configured to be shown.

methods.name: setShowPimSSN
methods.description: Configures whether the SSN column in PIM is visible.

methods.name: showPimSSN
methods.description: Checks if the SSN visibility in PIM is enabled.

methods.name: setShowPimSIN
methods.description: Configures whether the SIN column in PIM is visible.

methods.name: showPimSIN
methods.description: Checks if the SIN visibility in PIM is enabled.

methods.name: setShowPimTaxExemptions
methods.description: Sets whether to show tax exemptions in PIM.

methods.name: showPimTaxExemptions
methods.description: Checks if tax exemptions are shown in PIM.

methods.name: setAdminLocalizationDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Sets the default language code for admin localization.

methods.name: setAdminLocalizationUseBrowserLanguage
methods.description: Configures whether to use the browser's language for localization.

methods.name: setAdminLocalizationDefaultDateFormat
methods.description: Sets the default date format for admin localization.

methods.name: getAdminLocalizationUseBrowserLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves whether localization uses browser language setting.

methods.name: getAdminLocalizationDefaultDateFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the default date format for localization.

methods.name: getAdminLocalizationDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the default language code, falls back to 'en_US' if not set.

methods.name: getDefaultWorkShiftStartTime
methods.description: Gets the configured default start time for work shifts.

methods.name: setDefaultWorkShiftStartTime
methods.description: Sets the default start time for work shifts.

methods.name: getDefaultWorkShiftEndTime
methods.description: Gets the configured default end time for work shifts.

methods.name: setDefaultWorkShiftEndTime
methods.description: Sets the default end time for work shifts.

methods.name: getDefaultWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Calculates and returns the length of the default work shift in hours.

methods.name: getAllValues
methods.description: Retrieves all configuration key-value pairs as an array.

methods.name: getOpenIdProviderAdded
methods.description: Returns the configured OpenID provider addition state.

methods.name: setOpenIdProviderAdded
methods.description: Sets the OpenID provider addition state.

methods.name: getIntegrationsConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves XML configuration for open source integrations.

methods.name: setIntegrationsConfigValue
methods.description: Sets XML configuration for open source integrations.

methods.name: setInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Stores a unique identifier for the application instance.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the application instance identifier.

methods.name: getSendmailPath
methods.description: Returns the configured path for sending mail.

methods.name: getMaxAttachmentSize
methods.description: Returns maximum allowed attachment size (bytes).

methods.name: getAllowedFileTypes
methods.description: Returns list of allowed MIME types for file uploads.

methods.name: getAllowedFileExtensions
methods.description: Returns list of allowed file extension strings for uploads.

methods.name: getTimeSheetPeriodConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the timesheet period configuration value.

methods.name: setTimeSheetPeriodConfig
methods.description: Sets the timesheet period configuration value.

methods.name: setTimeSheetPeriodSetValue
methods.description: Sets whether the timesheet period has been defined.

methods.name: getTimesheetTimeFormatConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the timesheet time format configuration.

methods.name: getLDAPSetting
methods.description: Gets LDAP configuration as an LDAPSetting object.

methods.name: setLDAPSetting
methods.description: Stores LDAP configuration settings.

methods.name: getDashboardEmployeesOnLeaveTodayShowOnlyAccessibleConfig
methods.description: Checks if the dashboard shows only accessible employees on leave today.

methods.name: setDashboardEmployeesOnLeaveTodayShowOnlyAccessibleConfig
methods.description: Configures dashboard visibility for employees on leave today.

methods.name: showSystemCheckScreen
methods.description: Determines if the system check screen should be shown.

methods.name: setShowSystemCheckScreen
methods.description: Enables or disables the system check screen display.

methods.name: getOAuthEncryptionKey
methods.description: Retrieves the OAuth encryption key.

methods.name: getOAuthTokenEncryptionKey
methods.description: Retrieves the OAuth token encryption key.

methods.name: getOAuthAuthCodeTTL
methods.description: Returns the TTL for OAuth auth codes as a DateInterval.

methods.name: getOAuthRefreshTokenTTL
methods.description: Returns the TTL for OAuth refresh tokens as a DateInterval.

methods.name: getOAuthAccessTokenTTL
methods.description: Returns the TTL for OAuth access tokens as a DateInterval.
